title: Implementer brief: ork runs the check command itself; a sandbox limit is not an owner question

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S31 (2026-10-25): S78's Codex implementer (gpt-6.1-sol medium, workspace-write sandbox) could not run the Unix-socket tests in its sandbox and wrote 'Full-suite verification remains necessary on a runner that permits local Unix socket binds. No implementation decision is open.' under Owner needed. The engine paused the run for the owner (run ork-20261025-175709-e8c9). The engine runs the project check command itself in the checks state, outside the sandbox (docs/design.md:183-243, checks.deterministic), so this was not an owner question. Matrix row r9's note says the same.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md:86-122` (Owner needed and report part 7): say that ork runs the project check command after the round outside the role's sandbox; a check the role could not run because of its sandbox goes under deviations, not Owner needed.
- `internal/engine/brief.go:20-60` (BriefInput, BuildBrief): a CheckCommand field and the sentence that names it.
- `internal/engine/states.go` and `internal/engine/brief_test.go`: pass e.proj.CheckCommand into the brief; test it. Re-anchor from the code.
- `internal/roles/roles_test.go`: pin the new sentence.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Prompt text first (S115 placed Re-anchor and Self-check; keep its pinned strings). The guard in report.go is proposed; confirm at preflight.

Owner decisions (2026-10-25 session, AskUserQuestion): (1) the brief names the check command: add a CheckCommand field to BriefInput, filled from the project registry (registry.Project.CheckCommand, as perm.go:68 uses); the implementer brief says ork runs that command and slicer check after the round, outside the role's sandbox; with an empty CheckCommand it says only slicer check runs. (2) No guard in report.go: drop TestOwnerNeededWithoutQuestionIsShapeError. S111's structured questions cover it; file a later note if it is still needed after S111.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/roles ./internal/engine; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
